info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Pipeline Rest Services
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from the behavior of the live service and from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls it. Only parameters that were exercised against the live service are listed; the service may accept or ignore others, and it can change without notice. Service pipeline_rest_services. Both routes were verified: they return inspections, violations and enforcement actions for a facility (with a PipelineFlag), and accept either an FRS registry ID or the program system ID. XML output works. KNOWN SERVER BUG: when the id has no matching records (cnt 0) or is unknown, the JSON response has a trailing comma and is invalid, so strict JSON parsers fail; facilities that have records return valid JSON.

get.summary: Air inspections, violations and enforcement actions
get.description: Returns AirInspectionsViolationsEnforcementActions for an ICIS-Air ID or FRS registry ID.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output format. JSON (default), JSONP, or XML.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: JSONP callback. Name of the function in which to wrap the JSON response; used only with output=JSONP.

parameters.name: p_id
parameters.description: ICIS-Air ID (e.g. OH0000000123010434) or FRS registry ID.
